work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. XIV at 3895, its synopsis, and the actual Eugenius protocol at 3912–3917 identify one continuous act. The complaints, petition, grant, derogations and final clause run through 4156; the dating at 4158–4161 ends before XV at 4164. Boniface VIII at 4081–4082 is a predecessor reference within the derogation, not a new issuer or independent act. No displaced historical note belonging to this act was found in the context. The frozen empty date_raw is preserved despite its printed closing date.
